name: Seishokusha ~Ochiyuku Touma no Gakuen~
original_name: 征触者 ～堕ちゆく討魔の学園～
source:
Battle with a beautiful exorcist girl with black jack!
If you can beat them, you can see them falling into the pleasure world!

Magic seal have been expired, and many monsters are walking around in this world.
Hakuou School, which trains exorcists, have been training many female exorcists.

One day, a monster stepped into its door of the school.

He is a half human and half a monster, trying to prove his power to the Damon king by battling with those beautiful exorcists, humiliate them and make them obey him.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047783.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
用二十一點迎戰美少女退魔師！
只要贏過她們，就能欣賞她們墮入快感深淵的模樣！

魔法封印已經失效，大批妖魔在人間橫行。
專門培養退魔師的白凰學園也訓練出了眾多女性退魔師。

某天，一隻妖魔踏進學園大門。

他擁有半人半魔之身，為向魔王證明自己的力量，要與美麗的退魔師們交戰，凌辱她們，迫使她們臣服。

[譯自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047783.html/]英文版DLsite[/url]]
